pages.text: $(thing)Corn Smut$() ($(o)Ustilago maydis$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() maize.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores, soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 26-34 °C (best 30 °C).

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 3 years (soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 10% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Avoid wounding plants; Balanced fertility.$(br2)The galls are eaten as huitlacoche, a delicacy in Mexican cuisine.
